title: Angel note: what each bet cost to build and brought in

values: What each bet cost to build and what it brought in. SVB Payment Processed notices, Sep 2023 – Feb 2 2026, counted per "Angel note: how to count the money". Bet = notice Transaction Date: Domino Delights to Jan 8 2025, ZM Jan 9 – Nov 23 2025, Combo Fighter from Nov 24 2025.
Team on Deel, all counted as build. SVB shows it under two spellings, same account ***8380. 35 notices.
Leapblock's own close-out (Feb 13): 30 wires, $407,944, used instead of the notices ($374,654 on 29). The extra one is the first wire, $33,290 on Sep 13 2023, which has no notice in my mail.
Marcus’s company, direct monthly wire since Oct 2023. 28 notices.
Paid by the day. SVB shows their bank’s name (accounts ***3341, ***8605). 11 notices.
3 SVB wires ($6,450, Sep–Nov 2024) + 5 Western Union receipts in my mail, Jun–Aug 2024 ($7,525 sent; $0.99 fees left out).
Art direction and a look at our AI art pipeline. Paid end of May 2025.
Short animation job, coins and chests. Aug 2024.
2D animation, a week or two. Mar 2025.
UX job on the dominoes game (2nd half)
Second half of the UX job on the dominoes game, paid after the raise. Nov 2023.
Incent UA on iOS in the US. Marketing: listed under its bet, not in build cost. 3 notices.
Node Media, UA agency (late 2024 fees and creative concepts), one catch-up payment Jan 2 2025, so Domino Delights by date. Marketing, not in build cost.
Past-due UA bills (Aug 29 and Nov 12, 2025). Marketing, not in build cost.
First playable ad. SVB shows them as CREATIVE X TEKNOLOJi. Marketing, not in build cost.
$500/month contract to run paid UA on Telegram. Marketing, not in build cost. Oct 30 is ZM; Dec 1 and Jan 6 are Combo Fighter.
$125 wire of May 7 2024 came back the same day, so $0. It was re-sent via Payoneer, but only Payoneer payment requests reached my mail, no receipt, so it stays out.
Attribution tool, not one game. SVB shows it under two names, same account ***4015 ($25,000 Sep 2024, $6,250 Sep 2025).
Harmony Games logo/brand trademark filings, Nov 2023 – Mar 2025. 4 notices.
$500 for help on the 4X proposal, not one of the three games. May 2025.
Laptop paid direct to Martin, Oct 30 2025, in leva. Stays in BGN, not in any dollar total.
Aug 19 2024, $4,000 to our own Chase account (Blake, Feb 13): money moved between our own accounts, not spending. Kept at $0.
Team on Deel + studios and freelancers who made the games.
Ad networks, agencies, playables, ad video. Kept out of build cost.
Company (not one of the three games)
Legal, tools, website, trademarks, the 4X proposal. Plus 1,999.00 BGN for the laptop, not added in.
ANALYTICS.MONETIZATION.REVENUE_DAILY as recorded (IAP + ad). Combo Fighter left off until its first sales are checked.
Quick pass on the draft deck (all USD notices by date)
What changes: build only (marketing, Company, the own-account transfer and the returned wire out), plus Leapblock’s close-out and Lucas’s Western Union receipts.

body:
Line on the angel sheet: $407,944 (Build). Domino Delights $337,594 / ZM $59,250 / Combo Fighter $11,100.

Not what the notices add up to: the 29 SVB notices in my mail total $374,654. Leapblock's accountant closed our file on Feb 13 and told us what they received: 30 USD wires, $407,944 (2023 $104,868 incl. the first wire $33,290 on Sep 13 2023; 2024 $232,726; 2025 $62,950; 2026 $7,400). Per the counting note, their close-out beats the notices. The only difference is that first Sep 13 2023 wire, which has no notice in my mail; every year matches once it's included. Counted under Domino Delights by date.

Line on the angel sheet: $13,975 (Build, all Domino Delights by date).

Not what the notices add up to: the 3 SVB notices total $6,450 (Sep 25, Oct 23, Nov 21 2024, $2,150 each). Before those, Lucas was paid through Western Union, and the receipts reached my mail: Jun 3 $1,075, Jun 17 $1,075, Jun 29 $1,075, Jul 23 $2,150, Aug 23 2024 $2,150 = $7,525 sent (the $0.99 WU fees are left out, per the note). The WU "reviewing" and "picked up" emails are for the same transfers and aren't counted twice.

Line on the angel sheet: $0 (Marketing, ad videos).

Not what the notices add up to: the one SVB notice is $125 (May 7 2024), but per the note above that wire came back the same day, so it's $0. The Payoneer re-send only counts if a receipt reached my mail; all I have are two Payoneer payment requests from Dixelar for $125 (May 5 and Sep 25 2024), no receipt of a payment sent, so it stays out. Line kept at zero.

Line on the angel sheet: $0 (no bucket).

Not what the notices add up to: the one SVB notice is $4,000 on Aug 19 2024. Blake placed it on Feb 13 (Chase records thread): ***3203 is our own Chase account, he sent it over to put the money back after Carta's renewal came out of Chase. Money moved between our own accounts isn't spending, so the line is kept at zero.
